text:
sara: quick thought — can we move small per-shard headers out of the payload so the main blob is mmap-friendly? big win for cold-start if first page isn't touched repeatedly.

jason: we tried a header-sidecar for gptq packs. measured ~40% fewer page faults on pod start. pain points: warmup ordering lost the quick in-file header lookup and updates become trickier.

kai: agree. zero-copy payload is nice but warmup must fetch metadata first. otherwise warmup touches wrong ranges and thrashes.

sara: failure modes? partial writes, stale sidecar vs payload mismatch? what integrity checks do we need?

jason: stale sidecar is the biggest risk. object-store PUTs aren't atomic across multiple keys. we used a content-addressed manifest that references payload+sidecar digests and a small prefix checksum to detect mismatch quickly.

kai: prefetch behavior matters: some kernels fault on first access and cause a big spike. warmup should: 1) get header, 2) compute priorities, 3) touch a tiny prefix for selected shards to trigger mapping.

sara: proposed WeightSource/manifest additions: header_location in {"inline","sidecar","packed_blob"}, header_digest, header_size. loader probe reads header_location -> picks warmup path. require manifest update last so manifest points at current payload+header digests. integrity-check fallback on mismatch.

jason: plus: pack small headers into a per-model header-blob to avoid N GETs for models with many tiny shards. that blob can be updated atomically in single PUT.

kai: tradeoffs: per-shard sidecars = many small GETs; header-blob = one GET + mapping table. heuristic: if shard_count < 16 prefer blob; otherwise sidecar. make policy config-driven.

loader-bot: FYI: current warmup-scheduler assumes header is the first 4KB inline. if header_location != inline scheduler treats file as manifestless and defaults to lazy warmup.

sara: concrete next actions: 1) RFC patch for WeightSource manifest fields (small JSON example). 2) implement loader-probe that switches warmup plan based on header_location. 3) heuristic: shard_count < 16 -> header-blob, else per-shard sidecar. 4) pre-integrity read: read first 8KB checksum before mapping ranges.

jason: +1. add migration utility to backfill header-blob from existing inline headers.

kai: add loader.start(strict_integrity=true) flag to fail fast in CI/eval jobs rather than auto-fallback.

sara: who wants to prototype? i'll draft RFC follow-up and link this thread.

jason: i'll prototype per-model header-blob packer.

kai: i'll prototype sidecar semantics + warmup-probe changes.

loader-bot: reminder: weight-ingest sync Fri 11:00 if you want to pair.

sara: thanks — i'll post the RFC diff in #eng-ml and attach a tiny perf script. :thumbsup:
